lines.en: I march to the drumbeat, step by step.
This red coat is an old uniform.
My red coat rots, but my step stays steady.
Barrel low, I walk along the stone wall.

lines.zh: 红制服上的扣子，早就锈了。
lines.en: The buttons on my red coat rusted long ago.
A bullet tore through my epaulette.
My red coat is torn and my bones are loose.

lines.zh: 闪电劈中我这身红衣，火药都湿了。
lines.en: Lightning hit my red coat; the powder is soaked.
Even a dead man's stomach can be empty.

lines.zh: 骷髅弓箭手窥伺着你的弱点。

lines.en: It coldly smiles at your approach.

lines.zh: 你听到它在远处嘶哑的呼啸。
lines.en: You hear its hoarse wail in the distance.
At night, it wanders near the campfire.

lines.zh: 它在阴暗的洞穴中等待。

lines.en: Its arrows are coated with poison.
You try to lure it with food.
Its armor is tarnished with age.
It swings its spear at you.

lines.zh: 两者的骨头碰撞发出响声。
它敏捷地避开你的攻击。
它用盾牌抵御你的攻击。
lines.en: It uses its shield to block you.

lines.zh: 你与它的箭矢擦肩而过。
它的盔甲保护着它不受伤害。
lines.en: Its armor shields it from harm.

lines.zh: 你被它的盔甲反弹的攻击击中。
lines.en: Your attacks rebound off its armor.

lines.zh: 它的长矛深深插入土中。
lines.en: Its spear plunges into the ground.

lines.zh: 它们共同抵御敌人的攻击。

lines.en: It gathers food for its mate.

lines.zh: 它温柔地触摸它的配偶。

lines.en: It shields its mate from harm.

lines.zh: 它们一起探索未知的领地。
它们共同抵御夜晚的寒冷。
lines.en: They keep each other warm at night.
Hey! Your ender pearl, don’t move!
You won’t get away! I’ll catch you!

lines.zh: 你的头盔是我的下一个目标！
lines.en: Your helmet is my next target!
Pay the price with your life!
Your ammo belt is mine now.

lines.zh: 这袋火药，我先替你收着。
lines.en: I'll hold this powder bag for you.
The line advances, muskets firing together.

lines.zh: 我的红衣上有干涸的血。
lines.en: There's dried blood on my red coat.

lines.zh: 黑火药的味道，我认了百年。
lines.en: I've known the smell of black powder for a century.

lines.zh: 你身上没有红衣，那就是敌人。
lines.en: No red coat on you; then you are the enemy.
I died, but the gun still knows the way.
The copper barrel rises; don't blink.
I see you, get ready to shoot!
My red coat shows even through the smoke.
I seat the stock and hold my breath.
I raise the sight; the wind comes from the left.

lines.zh: 红制服上，火药味洗不掉。
lines.en: Gunpowder will not wash out of this red coat.

lines.zh: 红制服太重，可我的步枪很准。
lines.en: My red coat is heavy; my rifle is not.
Powder packed, the match cord burns.
The Redcoat's old gun aims at you.
Back into the corner and you're out of road.
My gun jammed; my blade did not.

lines.zh: 一百年前的战术，照样管用。
炮声一响，整片废墟都听见。
lines.en: One shot and the whole ruin hears it.
Reloading the second round; don't run.
Slice their arms off with sword!
Split their chests open with sword!
Slice their skin and flesh with sword!
Bayonet braced, I push into your chest.
The stock cracks across your face.

lines.zh: 我拿枪管挡你的刀，再砍。
lines.en: I block with the barrel, then cut.

lines.zh: 剑刃贴着你的锁骨过去。
lines.en: My blade passes along your collarbone.

lines.zh: 近身了，火药味呛你一脸。
lines.en: Up close, powder smoke chokes your face.
A bayonet flick, and you stagger back.

lines.zh: 泥土从我的领口往下掉。

lines.en: The grave soil loosens; the red coat rises.

lines.zh: 我带着那支没打完的枪回来。
lines.en: I return with the gun I never finished firing.

lines.zh: 军号早锈了，我还听得见。
lines.en: The bugle rusted long ago; I still hear it.

lines.zh: 老战场上，我又站起来了。
lines.en: On the old battlefield I stand again.

lines.zh: 火药袋着了，红衣烧得更红。
lines.en: My powder pouch ignites; the red coat burns redder.
My red coat is scorched; the epaulettes remain.

lines.zh: 红衣还没烂透，脸先烧了。
lines.en: My coat held. My face didn't.

lines.zh: 饿得我手抖，枪都端不稳。
lines.en: Hunger shakes my hands; I can't steady the gun.

lines.zh: 雷落在枪管上，我浑身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits my barrel and my whole body goes numb.

lines.zh: 红衣飘着，我还在往下掉。
lines.en: My red coat flutters as I keep falling.
